conventions.besselian: a = sum a_n t^n, t = hours of TDT from t0; x, y, l1, l2 in Earth equatorial radii, d and mu in degrees. mu is the ephemeris hour angle: the Greenwich hour angle plus 1.002738 * 15 deg/h * Delta-T.
conventions.limits: 'limits.start' and 'limits.end' are the extreme points of the path at sunrise and sunset (NASA's 'Limits' rows).
conventions.lunar_limb: Mean lunar limb (k2 for the umbra); limb profile not included (1-3 km).
conventions.ut: UT of each row; TD = UT + delta_t_s (the path page's value).

generator.description: NASA path tables (northern and southern limits of the umbra or antumbra and the central line every 120 s, WGS84, UT with the page's Delta-T) and polynomial Besselian elements for six solar eclipses, parsed verbatim.
generator.licence: U.S. Government work (NASA GSFC); acknowledgment requested.
generator.never_a_runtime_dependency: Development-time reference. CONVENTIONS section 11: never regenerate a fixture from Rust output.
